title: The Final Shot
content:
Emma had been playing basketball since she was ten years old. She was not the tallest player on her school team, but she was fast, focused, and never gave up.

One Saturday afternoon, her team was playing in the final of a local basketball tournament. The gym was full of students, parents, and teachers. Everyone was excited.

The game was difficult from the beginning. Both teams played well, and the score stayed very close. With only two minutes left, Emma's team was losing by three points.

During a timeout, the coach gathered the players together.

— We still have time. Stay calm and play as a team.

Emma took a deep breath and returned to the court.

A few seconds later, she received the ball near the three-point line. She passed it to her teammate, Mia, who scored a two-point basket.

Now the difference was only one point.

The other team tried to control the ball, but Emma managed to steal it. She ran toward the basket and passed to Mia again. Mia was fouled and went to the free-throw line. She scored one of her two free throws.

The score was tied.

There were only twenty seconds left.

The opposing team attacked quickly and scored another basket. Emma's team was now behind by two points.

The coach called another timeout.

— This is our last chance. Trust each other.

The game continued with only eight seconds remaining. Emma received the ball and moved quickly across the court. Two defenders tried to stop her, so she passed the ball to Mia.

Mia returned it immediately.

Emma was now just outside the three-point line.

There were two seconds left.

She jumped and released the ball.

Everyone watched it travel through the air.

The ball went through the hoop just before the final buzzer.

The gym exploded with cheers.

Emma's teammates ran toward her, celebrating the unexpected victory.

— We did it!

Emma smiled and looked at the scoreboard. She had learned something more important than how to make the final shot. In basketball, one player can make the shot, but a team makes the victory possible.
